patthana22.36:1.1: Nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ nasaraṇaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā anidassanaappaṭigho saraṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana22.36:2.1: Nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ naaraṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sanidassanasappaṭigho araṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… satta.
patthana22.36:3.1: Naanidassanasappaṭighaṃ naaraṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sanidassanasappaṭigho araṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… satta.

patthana22.36:8.1: Naanidassanasappaṭigho naaraṇo dhammo sanidassanasappaṭighassa araṇassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo… satta.

patthana22.36:11.1: Hetuyā ekavīsa, ārammaṇe tīṇi…pe… avigate ekavīsa.
patthana22.36:12.1: (Yathā kusalattike pañhāvārassa anulomampi paccanīyampi anulomapaccanīyampi paccanīyānulomampi gaṇitaṃ, evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ.) Dhammapaccanīyānulome tikadukapaṭṭhānaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.
